mission: Free digital filing cabinets for billions; durable, understandable, evidence-backed things and work products independent of intelligence and tools.

milestones.name: Recover and record reality
milestones.gate: Baseline, broad coverage, existing-work reconciliation, publishing access and operational inventory are resolved; local paperwork alone does not complete this milestone.

milestones.name: Publishable definitions and small common contracts
milestones.gate: Generic profile identity/publication, local discovery, distribution trust, compatibility boundaries and production SDK integration have evidence.

milestones.name: Research end to end
milestones.gate: Real investigations pass the complete two-implementation path while historical ORF fixtures retain their interpretation.

milestones.name: Prove generality
milestones.gate: Six diverse reference cases, identity/history/composition and standards mappings expose and resolve shared-model weaknesses.

milestones.name: Useful personal and organizational workflows
milestones.gate: Human hosts, connected ingestion, diagnostic coverage and scoped agency work without requiring technical users.

milestones.name: Open ecosystem and reproducible distribution
milestones.gate: External contributors publish and use profiles; public discovery, documentation, package installation and migrations are reproducible.

milestones.name: Stable, secure and sustainable service
milestones.gate: Governance, independent evidence, real-user success, operations, recovery, support and sustainability pass the declared release scope.

requirements.title: Preserve the charter, decisions and baseline
requirements.acceptance: A sanitized durable record preserves accepted direction, provisional choices, actual baseline identifiers and explicit limits.
requirements.note: Preserved from the locally tested bootstrap; human review remains open.

requirements.title: Check the plan and generate the roadmap
requirements.acceptance: All workstreams have requirements; dependencies and evidence resolve; cycles and false completed states fail; the generated roadmap cannot drift unnoticed.
requirements.note: Local checker and negative tests; external review pending.

requirements.title: Publish the reviewed change set
requirements.acceptance: Create an identifiable branch, verify every changed file, run repository CI, and open a PR without modifying production.
requirements.note: Bootstrap #5, ORF #6, Library #7 and Workbook #10 merged. Exact commits/CI are retained; merging does not establish independent approval or a released standard.

requirements.title: Reconcile existing plans and in-flight work
requirements.acceptance: Cross-repository inventory retains docs/opf and branch work, records owners/overlap and preserves incomplete acceptance gates.
requirements.note: Reorganization #8 reconciles the merged Foundation baseline. Hub, Browsers, Primboard, governance and Desktop preflight increments merged; historical SDK/docs/product branches and repository cutovers remain.

requirements.title: Project coordination without duplicate authority
requirements.acceptance: Issues/PRs and future UI cite stable requirement IDs; scope changes, decisions, risks and evidence remain traceable to the ledger.

requirements.title: Keep a resumable and honest checkpoint
requirements.acceptance: A replacement worker can identify inputs, changes, commands, evidence, blocked publication and the exact next step without private chat reconstruction.
requirements.note: HANDOFF.md and GOAL-STATUS.md now identify exact merged increments, tested scope and the next access/real-use gates. No unattended agent is running.

requirements.title: Define stewardship and decision rights
requirements.acceptance: Approved charter, maintainer/succession/dispute processes, public decisions and the Foundation/commercial boundary.
requirements.note: Contribution/security/lifecycle defaults merged in .github. Admin enforcement, legal decisions and independent stewardship remain open.

requirements.title: Set legal, IP and licensing policy
requirements.acceptance: Human-reviewed contribution, license, trademark, privacy and publisher terms; no assumed legal status.

requirements.title: Govern standards maturity and change
requirements.acceptance: Versioned RFC lifecycle, breaking-change review, deprecation/retraction rules and maintained decision history.

requirements.title: Prove independent stewardship
requirements.acceptance: An outside contributor can propose and maintain a profile; ownership transfer and an abandoned-maintainer case are resolved.

requirements.title: Reconcile small substrate and current primitives
requirements.acceptance: A small-substrate design is exercised against Research and six minimal scenarios; semantic concepts and packaging/tool primitives are reconciled without requiring a universal table/schema rewrite.
requirements.note: Research, Person and Decision exercise one generic creation-kit contract; receipt, contract, project and system cases plus reconciliation of the whole substrate remain open.

requirements.title: Define interoperable identity and references
requirements.acceptance: Object identity, revision identity, cross-pack links, context membership and unknown types have explicit collision/offline semantics.

requirements.title: Define bounded packaging and inspection
requirements.acceptance: Archive, media, encoding, resource limits and generic human entry points work without a hosted account; unsupported content is preserved.

requirements.title: Separate authoritative records and views
requirements.acceptance: Two tools edit/save without inventing competing authoritative files; exported documents identify source revision and transformation.

requirements.title: Discover independent profile packages
requirements.acceptance: Local manifest discovery finds multiple profiles in one source, detects duplicates, rejects unsafe metadata/paths, and never executes package code.
requirements.note: Local implementation only; no package publication, production SDK integration, or security certification.

requirements.title: Pin immutable package distributions
requirements.acceptance: Complete package digests, authenticated provenance, lockfiles, source moves, rollback and offline caches are tested; hashes are not truth claims.
requirements.note: Canonical resources and definition/snapshot pins are verified in the installable Library and bundled Hub. Published immutable distribution, release trust and independent review remain open.

requirements.title: Resolve versions, names and dependencies
requirements.acceptance: Publisher namespaces, aliases, transfers, version negotiation, dependency cycles and deprecated/retracted packages have explicit tested behavior.

requirements.title: Make authoring independent of Foundation hosting
requirements.acceptance: A third party authors, tests and publishes from another repository/private source with useful errors and without creating a Foundation repo.
requirements.note: Clean installed Library creates four profile instances locally and pins definitions; private instance contents are not public MCP inputs. Wider independent authoring acceptance remains.

requirements.title: Generate the local profile catalog
requirements.acceptance: PROFILE.md metadata generates a deterministic local catalog; drift fails; legacy registry remains unchanged until consumer migration.
requirements.note: Four-profile development catalog now feeds the Library and side-by-side Cloudflare Hub preview. Production website/registry cutover remains open.

requirements.title: Implement private and external resolution
requirements.acceptance: Public/private sources, permissions, credentials, mirrors, origin policy and offline failures are tested without leaking instance contents.

requirements.title: Ship human and agent discovery surfaces
requirements.acceptance: Search, filters, version pages, documentation and API serve one source model; official/publisher/conformance/security states are distinct.
requirements.note: Hub preview is deployed with human pages, JSON and MCP from the four-profile canonical bundle. Homepage observed live; hosted CI 34146877288 passes all four canonical kits, HTTP/assets/CSP and negative boundaries through the external SDK in auto/legacy modes. Accessibility, independent acceptance and old-site migration remain open.

requirements.title: Operate a trustworthy directory
requirements.acceptance: Moderation, abuse, reports, retention, takedown/retraction, package ownership and privacy-preserving opt-in metrics have runbooks and tests.

requirements.title: Preserve and test ORF compatibility
requirements.acceptance: Pin actual ORF source/fixtures, run the original validator, retain negative cases, and require explicit loss-reporting differential migration tests.
requirements.note: Pinned all 15 upstream files; original CLI and both modes exercised; transport and inspection round trips tested. Target Research vNext semantic migration and independent review remain open.

requirements.title: Implement lasting research records
requirements.acceptance: Question/scope, sources, claims, evidence relationships, counterevidence, methods and uncertainty interoperate without a particular agent harness.
requirements.note: Native experimental research.json now has schema, creation template, references, contradiction and recorded review fields through generic tooling. Authenticated review, full lifecycle and ORF semantic migration remain open.

requirements.title: Implement research lifecycle and review
requirements.acceptance: Continue, challenge, correct, refresh, redact, supersede and retract while distinguishing factual support, workflow state, freshness and authorization.

requirements.title: Prove the Research end-to-end path
requirements.acceptance: Two independent workers/readers use pinned definitions, preserve evidence and disagreement, render outputs and round-trip legacy examples; outcomes are retained.

requirements.title: Resolve identity without overmerging
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate, ambiguous and contradictory identities and roles retain source evidence; uncertain matches are reversible proposals.

requirements.title: Compose without silently copying authority
requirements.acceptance: Nested/linked Prims, reused evidence, cycles and partial availability preserve references, provenance and bounded expansion.

requirements.title: Handle revisions and concurrent edits
requirements.acceptance: Revision history, stale-writer detection, conflicts, corrections, branch/merge and cross-device synchronization are tested without silent overwrite.

requirements.title: Implement context boundaries and uncertainty
requirements.acceptance: Membership in multiple contexts does not grant permissions; disputed/time-scoped relationships remain distinct from current accepted state.

requirements.title: Integrate production SDK and CLI contracts
requirements.acceptance: Reference profile behavior is integrated with the existing SDK/CLI; versioned interfaces, error codes and backwards compatibility pass regression tests.

requirements.title: Provide authoring and debugging tools
requirements.acceptance: Scaffolding, validate/explain, migrations, fixtures and examples let unfamiliar developers complete a task without founder help.

requirements.title: Expose safe agent operation contracts
requirements.acceptance: Read/query/propose/update/validate/render interfaces are discoverable with scoped access, receipts, idempotency and explicit unsupported operations.

requirements.title: Make cross-language behavior reproducible
requirements.acceptance: At least two implementations share fixtures; packaged install, serialization, large inputs and compatibility tests run from clean environments.

requirements.title: Provide a useful generic reader
requirements.acceptance: Unfamiliar profiles, missing viewers and offline packs remain readable; semantic data and evidence are accessible without running arbitrary embedded code.

requirements.title: Prove desktop open-edit-save
requirements.acceptance: Supported platforms have explicit matrices; a real app opens attachments, edits, saves and exports the actual file with no hidden competing store.
requirements.note: Desktop still imports an unavailable sibling PrimSimCore source. Proof now fails before live probes instead of skipping source tests and claiming success. Recover authoritative source, then reconcile Mac integration PRs and verify signed-device behavior.

requirements.title: Support mobile and accessible use
requirements.acceptance: Phone reading/sharing, keyboard/screen-reader access, low-resource devices, localization and intermittent connectivity pass representative usability tasks.

requirements.title: Make ordinary filing and retrieval work
requirements.acceptance: Import, search, relationships, corrections, recovery and export work without GitHub/terminal/ontology knowledge; unsupported cases remain visible.

requirements.title: Define extraction contracts
requirements.acceptance: Connectors preserve original evidence, source IDs, timestamps, permissions and allowed inferences; contract tests cover incrementality and idempotency.

requirements.title: Bound recursive artifact handling
requirements.acceptance: Nested archives/media, duplicate children, encryption, malformed/hostile inputs and partial parse failures have quotas, lineage and resumability.

requirements.title: Respect change, revocation and deletion
requirements.acceptance: Source correction/deletion, disconnected accounts, permission loss, sync conflicts and redaction propagate through explicit policies and audit receipts.

requirements.title: Prove operational ingestion
requirements.acceptance: Retries, backpressure, cancellation, stale connections, recoverable failures and costs are visible; representative local and remote connectors pass real-use gates.

requirements.title: Separate knowledge, capability and authority
requirements.acceptance: A record describing a capability never grants it; actor claims and authorization receipts are distinguished and tested.

requirements.title: Implement scoped delegation
requirements.acceptance: Read/write/propose scopes, human approvals, expiry, revocation, multi-context isolation and emergency stop are exercised against actual enforcement.

requirements.title: Integrate external work systems
requirements.acceptance: Tasks, agent identities, bounded sandboxes and domain acceptance connect through explicit contracts without embedding an orchestrator in every Prim.

requirements.title: Bound autonomous work
requirements.acceptance: Budgets, deadlines, concurrency, retries, approvals, durable state and accountable receipts work in an explicitly configured runtime; chat never implies unattended execution.

requirements.title: Maintain the threat model
requirements.acceptance: Untrusted definitions, instance data, scripts, renderers, sources, agents, logs and indexes have abuse cases and trust boundaries before network execution.
requirements.note: Public definition/private instance boundary retained. Browser imported authentication defects fixed and tested; Primboard storage and mixed-version limits documented. Independent threat-model review remains.

requirements.title: Protect sensitive records and keys
requirements.acceptance: Encryption/key recovery, private/public separation, grants, secret references, rotation, redacted sharing and revocation are tested without secret values in packs.
requirements.note: Primboard normal startup stops backlog seeding; locked current-version mutations, stale-index rejection and atomic private file replacement pass macOS CI. Encrypted metadata, backup and real-store acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Isolate untrusted processing
requirements.acceptance: Archive traversal/bombs, parser exhaustion, unsafe renderers, prompt injection, validator execution and dependency supply-chain risks have tests and sandbox boundaries.
requirements.note: Browser login/gateway sources consolidated with verified Apple identity and fail-closed session/fleet handling. Synthetic tests and dry builds pass; real-account/container and isolation acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Establish security response
requirements.acceptance: Disclosure/contact process, scoped independent review, incident handling, revocation/retraction and security regression evidence exist before stable public claims.
requirements.note: Organization SECURITY.md is merged; private reporting configuration, response ownership and actual incident/recovery practice remain administration/operations gates.

requirements.title: Map domains without proliferating types
requirements.acceptance: Coverage spans overlapping personal/family/household/work/business/community Worlds or contexts with unknown and deliberately unfiled states; domains are not automatic new schemas or one folder taxonomy.

requirements.title: Implement six diverse reference cases
requirements.acceptance: Person, receipt, contract, project, decision and system expose identity, evidence, commitments, history, capability/authority and context problems with retained fixtures.
requirements.note: Research/Person/Decision kits retained; first sanitized Workbook incubator profile imported with exact source provenance. This does not replace the remaining six-reference-case obligations.

requirements.title: Build diagnostic coverage, not vanity scores
requirements.acceptance: Life diagnostics distinguish Coverage, Fidelity and Operability, including unknown, absent, unfiled, stale, contradictory and inaccessible; silence and imported item counts are not completeness.

requirements.title: Test diverse real-life arrangements
requirements.acceptance: Representative households/organizations, languages, units/currencies/dates, accessibility, low-resource/offline use and transfer/estate continuity pass scoped user tests.

requirements.title: Publish version-specific conformance fixtures
requirements.acceptance: Positive/negative and adversarial cases separately cover packaging, manifest, profile semantics, migrations and unsupported-validator states.
requirements.note: Pinned legacy fixtures and adversarial preservation/interpretation cases exist. Full category/vNext conformance and independent review remain open.

requirements.title: Map relevant existing standards
requirements.acceptance: Study and document provenance/research-object mappings, citations and export loss; round-trip fixtures prove actual support, not a logo or proposal.

requirements.title: Issue evidence-backed compatibility results
requirements.acceptance: Reports identify implementation/version/environment and exact checks; publisher identity, security, semantic review and truth remain separate judgments.

requirements.title: Prove heterogeneous interoperability
requirements.acceptance: Two independent implementations exchange/edit/reopen artifacts without losing unknown fields or evidence; partial support is reported accurately.

requirements.title: Inventory consumers before cutover
requirements.acceptance: Existing registries, profiles, SDKs, products and in-flight branches have owners and dependency maps; compatibility decisions preserve open obligations.
requirements.note: Source commits, runtime IDs, route/cookie boundaries and open Desktop PRs recorded. Complete production consumer inventory and route migration remain before renames/archives.

requirements.title: Create reproducible release gates
requirements.acceptance: Clean installs/builds, pinned dependencies, supported-platform tests, signing where applicable and artifact provenance are demonstrated.
requirements.note: Exact-commit CI passes Foundation, Hub, both browser Workers and 121 macOS Primboard tests/release build/selftest. Desktop source preflight blocks honestly; notarized releases and independent gates remain.

requirements.title: Migrate without a flag day
requirements.acceptance: Aliases, read-old/write-new policy, migration receipts, originals, restore/rollback and deprecated repositories have tested, authorized procedures.
requirements.note: Sanitized Workbook import and valid legacy browser session/read-old notebook behavior are tested. No route, user-store, repository rename or archive cutover performed.

requirements.title: Define stable acceptance and maintenance
requirements.acceptance: Release readiness covers real users, docs, support, operations and security; older supported versions remain available and their obligations assigned.

requirements.title: Inventory infrastructure and approve costs
requirements.acceptance: Actual providers, domains, services, access boundaries, owners and operating budgets are verified; no guessed deployments or unapproved spend.
requirements.note: Clawdflare confirms the Eidos AGI account, active prims.sh zone and existing Prim Workers. Isolated Hub preview now has five Static Assets and a deployed version at 100%. Foundation legal ownership, operator/cost ownership and production budgets remain open.

requirements.title: Operate reliable public services
requirements.acceptance: Monitoring, SLOs, rate limits, deployment/rollback, incident response, capacity and abuse costs have working runbooks and evidence.

requirements.title: Prove recovery and exit
requirements.acceptance: Backups and restore drills, key loss, publisher/service disappearance, offline export, mirrors and service/vendor migration pass explicit recovery goals.
requirements.note: Hub and browser preview/cutover rollback procedures committed; no actual deployment recovery or user-data restore drill yet.

requirements.title: Sustain a useful free core
requirements.acceptance: The open/free core and optional funded services have an approved model, measurable costs and continuity planning; no unlimited hosting subsidy is implied.

requirements.title: Make onboarding self-service
requirements.acceptance: A new user and a new publisher each complete a real task from public instructions without founder intervention.

requirements.title: Provide maintainable education and support
requirements.acceptance: Examples, domain guides, contribution templates, support channels, release notes and localization paths have responsible maintainers.

requirements.title: Measure adoption honestly
requirements.acceptance: Success/retention and friction are assessed with consent and privacy boundaries; install counts do not certify quality or usefulness.

requirements.title: Establish outside participation
requirements.acceptance: External users, maintainers and integrations provide retained feedback; feedback changes traceable requirements rather than creating parallel ad-hoc plans.

requirements.title: Serve the Foundation library through MCP
requirements.acceptance: Official SDK stdio and Streamable HTTP serve bounded search, exact definitions, versions, resources, creation kits and rankings; tools never require private instance contents.
requirements.note: Merged stdio/HTTP Library and deployed Cloudflare preview are tested with the external SDK. Hosted CI 34146877288 passes both modes and all four canonical creation kits. Independent security review and production operational acceptance remain open.

requirements.title: Ship a reproducibly installable MCP package
requirements.acceptance: A built wheel includes its definition snapshot, installs in a clean environment, and completes creation plus protocol tests outside the checkout; reviewed publication and supported-client matrix remain explicit.
requirements.note: Clean wheel installation, pip check and installed stdio smoke passed for all four development profiles. No package index release or independent review.

requirements.title: Provide generic version-pinned creation kits
requirements.acceptance: A new profile supplies schema, blank template, authority filename and declarative rules; an agent can create locally without a type-specific endpoint or model dependency.
requirements.note: Research, Person, Decision and Workbook creation kits match canonical schemas/templates/rules/authority and digests through Library and Hub. No independent review or stable release claimed.

requirements.title: Expose one public library across human, JSON and MCP views
requirements.acceptance: All surfaces share hashes and exact versions; unknown definitions do not silently substitute; catalog resources never expose private instances.
requirements.note: Canonical bundle, human pages, JSON and MCP pass same-source checks and real local Worker parity in CI. Deployment and independent review remain open.

requirements.title: Rank genuine adoption and recent momentum
requirements.acceptance: Popular and trending are explicit reproducible policies; replay, duplicate adoption, reversible stars, stale snapshots and insufficient cohorts are tested; no invented launch votes or quality claims.
requirements.note: Implementation and tests available; independent review and activation/release gates remain open.

requirements.title: Activate authenticated consented popularity collection
requirements.acceptance: Verified collector identity, consent, revocation, anti-Sybil controls, anomaly review and user star/unstar experience operate before public collection is enabled; telemetry remains optional.

requirements.title: Automate approved definition publication and refresh
requirements.acceptance: Multiple external/local sources are indexed into immutable snapshots with maintainer provenance, withdrawal and review; installations can update with digest pins and rollback without one repository per type.

requirements.title: Launch the Foundation-owned public MCP endpoint
requirements.acceptance: Confirm hosting owner and budget; deploy a pinned reviewed release with TLS, origin/host policies, edge quotas, health monitoring and rollback; connect a real external MCP host.
requirements.note: Isolated Hub preview is live with version 03266017-e4df-42f4-beda-fe656a095767; hosted HTTP/MCP parity passes in CI 34146877288. Upload token failure resolved without account credential extraction or reconnection. Named ownership, cost, edge quotas, monitoring, recovery and production cutover remain open.

requirements.title: Make library adoption self-service
requirements.acceptance: Publish actual install artifacts and client instructions; test unfamiliar users finding definitions and producing valid local Prims; any public example-instance sharing must be opt-in and separate from definition discovery.
requirements.note: Installable artifact and generic host instructions are supplied; independent user onboarding and client-directory publication remain unverified.
